{
  "settings": [
    {
      "path": "analysis.asset_thresholds.network_payload_max_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 4194304,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Whole-page payload budget in captured content-decoded bytes -- the document plus every declared subresource that was actually fetched; incomplete declaration coverage remains a lower bound."
    },
    {
      "path": "analysis.asset_thresholds.page_weight_max_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 2097152,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Native declared-resource page budget in captured content-decoded bytes; incomplete runtime payloads remain lower bounds."
    },
    {
      "path": "analysis.asset_thresholds.resource_max_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 2097152,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Native per-resource budget in captured content-decoded bytes; defaults to 2 MiB."
    },
    {
      "path": "analysis.canonical_policy.filters",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Ordered URL-regex policies for configured filter pages: [{'pattern': ..., 'policy': 'self|landing', 'target': absolute URL}]. Landing policies require an explicit target; the first matching rule wins. Empty means unmeasured, not a finding."
    },
    {
      "path": "analysis.canonical_policy.pagination",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Ordered URL-regex policies for paginated pages: [{'pattern': ..., 'policy': 'self|first_page|landing', 'target': absolute URL}]. Non-self policies require an explicit target; the first matching rule wins. Empty means unmeasured, not a finding."
    },
    {
      "path": "analysis.finding_exclusions",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Post-crawl finding suppressions only; never narrows URLs fetched. Ordered rules use Python regex search on a finding's target_url, optional exact check IDs, and a required reason. First matching rule wins."
    },
    {
      "path": "analysis.redirect_hop_hsts_probe",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Opt-in probe of the start URL's host variants (http/https, bare/www): walks each redirect hop and records its status and Strict-Transport-Security, feeding MISSING_HSTS_ON_REDIRECT_HOP. A few live requests beyond the crawl itself."
    },
    {
      "path": "analysis.segments",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Post-crawl segment rules: [{'name': ..., 'rules': [{'op': 'eq|prefix|contains|regex|in|segment', 'field': ..., 'value': ...}]}]. Rules may use page fields or another segment."
    },
    {
      "path": "cache.invalidate",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Force every cache lookup to miss (a live measurement happens) while still writing the result back to the cache. Does not disable the cache; 'cache.mode=off' does that. Rejected together with cache.mode='replay', which promises the opposite guarantee."
    },
    {
      "path": "cache.mode",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "off",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "'off' (default: no cache), 'live' (real HTTP freshness: max-age/Expires, ETag/Last-Modified revalidation), or 'replay' (serve any cached entry regardless of age, without revalidating; a URL with no entry yet is still fetched live)."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.external.crawl",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "After the internal frontier closes, check each recorded external destination once — opt-in, bounded by external_checks.*, never recursive. Requires discovery.external.store and a site crawl (--url); refused on the native SQLite route and in list mode."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.external.store",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": true,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Keep discovered external links in the report."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.follow_nofollow",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Follow links marked rel=nofollow instead of skipping them."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.hyperlinks.crawl",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": true,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Request discovered hyperlinks (fetch them)."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.hyperlinks.store",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": true,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Keep discovered hyperlinks in the report."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.record_invalid_targets",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Record hrefs that cannot become fetchable link targets (unparsable syntax, a non-http(s) scheme) per page, with the raw attribute value and the rejection reason. Off by default; recorded targets are data and never enter the frontier."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.redirects.crawl",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": true,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Request discovered redirect targets (fetch them)."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.resolve_canonical_destination",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "List mode only: follow a fetched page's canonical declaration through a bounded chain, recording every inspected target without adding it to the page population."
    },
    {
      "path": "discovery.resolve_redirect_destination",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "List mode only: follow a fetched redirect past its first hop to where it actually lands, recording every hop. Depth stays 0; this is a per-URL chain walk, not link discovery."
    },
    {
      "path": "evidence.content_area.exclude_selectors",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "CSS selectors excluded from the saved main-content signature."
    },
    {
      "path": "evidence.content_area.exclude_tags",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [
        "nav",
        "header",
        "aside",
        "footer"
      ],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "HTML element names excluded from the saved main-content signature."
    },
    {
      "path": "evidence.content_area.include_selector",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Optional CSS selector for included main-content regions."
    },
    {
      "path": "evidence.content_area.root_selector",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Optional CSS root within which main content is extracted."
    },
    {
      "path": "evidence.extraction_rules",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Bounded declarative extraction rules; no executable code or arbitrary regular expressions."
    },
    {
      "path": "evidence.retain_no_store_acknowledged",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Allow bounded SQLite body retention for anonymous responses carrying Cache-Control: no-store; off by default and never permits credentialed response retention."
    },
    {
      "path": "external_checks.max_depth",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Hops of same-host links followed on external pages that answered; 0 checks recorded destinations only. Off-host links are never followed."
    },
    {
      "path": "external_checks.max_hosts",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 20,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Distinct external origins the opt-in check may contact at most; redirect hops count toward it, since a redirect is a request to another origin."
    },
    {
      "path": "external_checks.max_redirects",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 5,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Redirect hops followed per external destination before the chain is recorded unresolved; hard ceiling is 10."
    },
    {
      "path": "external_checks.max_requests",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "HTTP attempts the external check may spend, including redirect hops and retries; 0 means no phase-specific cap. Separate from limits.max_requests."
    },
    {
      "path": "external_checks.max_targets",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 100,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Distinct external destinations the opt-in check may fetch at most — recorded outlinks plus same-host continuations admitted under max_depth. Destinations past the budget are recorded as skipped, not silently dropped."
    },
    {
      "path": "fetch.retry_server_errors",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Retry a page-level 5xx response up to this many times (0-3); each retry is a real request against limits.max_requests and the pacing delay, the throttle's server-error back-off applies between attempts, and only the final response is recorded as the page."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.auth",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Host-bound HTTP Basic/Digest entries: [{'host': 'example.test', 'scheme': 'basic|digest', 'username_env': 'env:USER_VAR', 'password_env': 'env:PASS_VAR'}]."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.auth_acknowledged",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Must be true when http.auth is non-empty; authenticated crawls follow site links."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.credential_headers",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Host-bound extra headers for authenticated crawling: [{'host': ..., 'headers': {name: 'env:VAR_NAME'}}]."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.credentials_acknowledged",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Must be true for http.credential_headers to take effect."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.headers",
      "type": "dict",
      "default": {},
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Extra request headers to send with every fetch. With --set, pass a JSON object."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.proxy",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Explicit http:// forward proxy with host and port, or env:VARIABLE containing its URL and optional username/password. No ambient proxy variables are used by a native crawl."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.proxy_allow_private",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Explicitly allow only the configured proxy endpoint to resolve privately; target URL private-network guards remain unchanged."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.proxy_authenticated",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Whether the resolved proxy used authentication; managed by the crawler."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.proxy_identity",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Resolved nonsecret proxy endpoint; managed by the crawler, not user input."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.retry_on_timeout",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Number of retries after a request times out."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.timeout_seconds",
      "type": "float",
      "default": 15.0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Per-request timeout in seconds."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.upgrade_to_https",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Fetch every http URL over https instead, before any request: no redirect hop is recorded for the upgrade, the two spellings collapse into one page, and each upgraded page is marked. Turn on only for hosts that enforce transport security -- a host without https answers with connection errors."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.user_agent",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Request User-Agent string; empty uses the toolkit's identifiable default."
    },
    {
      "path": "http.zstd",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Request zstd-compressed HTTP response bodies when Python's stdlib or the optional zstandard decoder is available."
    },
    {
      "path": "limits.max_crawl_seconds",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Wall-clock budget for the whole crawl; 0 means no limit."
    },
    {
      "path": "limits.max_depth",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 5,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Maximum link depth from the start URL; -1 disables the depth limit for native SQLite site scans."
    },
    {
      "path": "limits.max_query_variants_per_path",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 5,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Maximum distinct query strings kept per URL path."
    },
    {
      "path": "limits.max_requests",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 20000,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Total HTTP attempts for the crawl, including bootstrap, redirects and retries; 0 means no total-attempt limit. Explicit values may be at most 2,000,000, allowing robots, sitemaps, redirects and retries above the URL budget."
    },
    {
      "path": "limits.max_response_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 5242880,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Response bodies larger than this are truncated before parsing."
    },
    {
      "path": "limits.max_url_length",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 2000,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "URLs longer than this are not fetched."
    },
    {
      "path": "limits.max_urls",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 200,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Maximum number of URLs the crawl will fetch; 0 disables the URL limit for native SQLite site scans, which collect until their queue is exhausted. Values above 1,000,000 are refused rather than clamped; narrow the scope instead."
    },
    {
      "path": "link_attributes.capture",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Store each link's full rel tokens, target attribute, and raw (pre-resolution) href -- needed for unsafe-cross-origin-link and protocol-relative-link detection, at a real memory cost on a large crawl."
    },
    {
      "path": "link_position.classify",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Classify each link's DOM ancestry (nav/header/sidebar/footer/content) as it is parsed, at no extra requests; off by default because storing a position per link costs memory on a large crawl."
    },
    {
      "path": "link_position.rules",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Ordered [{'position', 'selector'}] overrides for the built-in nav/header/sidebar/footer selectors; empty keeps the built-ins. Only read when classify is true."
    },
    {
      "path": "output.dir",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": false,
      "description": "Directory to write pages.jsonl and audit.json into; empty writes nothing to disk."
    },
    {
      "path": "output.write_decisions_jsonl",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": true,
      "results_affecting": false,
      "description": "Write one JSON line per exclusion decision to decisions.jsonl, naming the URL and the rule that rejected it — see seohead.checks.logscan for what reads it."
    },
    {
      "path": "output.write_pages_jsonl",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": true,
      "results_affecting": false,
      "description": "Write one JSON line per fetched page to pages.jsonl."
    },
    {
      "path": "output.write_tasks",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": true,
      "results_affecting": false,
      "description": "Write the prioritized backlog beside audit.json as tasks.json and tasks.md — the same pipeline `sf run --tasks` uses, run over this crawl's own audit."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.actions",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Bounded declarative page actions (click, scroll, wait_for_selector, wait_ms, extract); extract reads selector-based text or href/value fields; no user-supplied JavaScript."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.artifacts.console_errors",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": false,
      "description": "Capture browser console error messages per rendered URL."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.artifacts.screenshot_mode",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "full_page",
      "results_affecting": false,
      "description": "Capture the full page or only the initial viewport when screenshots are enabled."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.artifacts.screenshots",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": false,
      "description": "Save one screenshot per rendered URL."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.device_pixel_ratio",
      "type": "float",
      "default": 1.0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Device scale factor used for rendering."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.engine",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "chromium",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Headless engine Playwright launches: 'chromium', 'firefox' or 'webkit'. An unsupported name fails validation; an uninstalled browser binary reports a distinct install hint. Firefox cannot emulate a mobile viewport (is_mobile)."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.flatten_iframes",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Replace same-origin iframes with their own document's body content before capture."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.flatten_shadow_dom",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Merge open shadow roots into their host elements before capturing the DOM."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.mobile_emulation",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Emulate a mobile device (touch UA, is_mobile)."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.page_concurrency",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 1,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Maximum browser pages/contexts rendered at once during JS escalation; 1 keeps sequential behaviour. A rendering bound, not HTTP crawl concurrency."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.persistent_profile",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Unavailable with the pinned renderer: requested persistent profiles return an explicit unavailable result and are not opened. Off by default."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.persistent_profile_dir",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": false,
      "description": "Directory for the persistent profile; required when persistent_profile is true, and never a computed default."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.remote_endpoint_env",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Name of an environment variable containing the remote ws/wss endpoint; never store the endpoint in a scan."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.remote_playwright_version",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Operator-declared remote Playwright version; its major/minor must match the installed client."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.remote_protocol",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "playwright",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Remote browser protocol; only Playwright is supported, not CDP."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.resize_to_content",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Grow the viewport to the rendered page's own height before capture, capped by resize_to_content_max_height_px."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.resize_to_content_max_height_px",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 15000,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Deterministic cap on resize_to_content, so an unbounded page is truncated rather than crawled forever."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.script_timeout_seconds",
      "type": "float",
      "default": 10.0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "How long JavaScript may keep running after the page and its subresources have loaded, before the DOM is captured."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.touch_emulation",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Emulate touch input."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.transport",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "local",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Launch a local browser (default) or connect to an explicitly supplied remote Playwright server."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.viewport",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "desktop",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Viewport preset used for rendering: 'desktop' or 'mobile'."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.viewport_height",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Custom viewport height in CSS pixels (0 = unset). Must be set together with viewport_width; the pair overrides the named preset's dimensions."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.viewport_width",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Custom viewport width in CSS pixels (0 = unset). Must be set together with viewport_height; the pair overrides the named preset's dimensions."
    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.browser.wait_until",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "load",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Page-load strategy before script_timeout_seconds starts counting down: 'load', 'domcontentloaded', or 'networkidle'."

    {
      "path": "rendering.escalation.max_render_seconds",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Wall-clock budget for the escalation step; 0 means no limit."

    {
      "path": "rendering.escalation.max_render_urls",

      "default": 30,

      "description": "Maximum number of pages re-fetched under the fuller representation, across all escalated patterns combined."

      "path": "rendering.escalation.policy",

    {
      "path": "rendering.escalation.sample_per_pattern",
      "type": "int",

      "path": "rendering.mode",

    {
      "path": "rendering.presets",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Opt-in named page-action presets: expand_tabs, load_more, read_datalayer."

    {
      "path": "rendering.rendered_links.crawl",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,

    {
      "path": "rendering.rendered_links.store",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Store eligible a[href] route observations from static and rendered documents; this records evidence only and never crawls discovered routes."

    {
      "path": "resources.fetch",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": false,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "SQLite only: opt in to fetching directly declared same-origin scripts and stylesheets; never follows CSS imports or JavaScript modules."
    },
    {
      "path": "resources.graph.max_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 104857600,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "scan.v2 only: total bytes accepted by the declared-resource graph."
    },
    {
      "path": "resources.graph.max_bytes_per_resource",
      "type": "int",

    {
      "path": "limits.max_query_variants_per_path",

      "default": 5,

    {
      "path": "limits.max_requests",

      "results_affecting": true,

    {
      "path": "limits.max_response_bytes",

      "path": "limits.max_url_length",

    {

    {
      "path": "link_position.classify",

    },
    {
      "path": "output.write_tasks",

    },
    {
      "path": "rendering.actions",

    {

      "path": "rendering.browser.remote_endpoint_env",

      "path": "rendering.browser.resize_to_content",

      "path": "resources.graph.max_bytes_per_resource",

    {
      "path": "resources.graph.max_redirects",

    {
      "path": "resources.graph.max_requests",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 2000,
      "results_affecting": true,

    {
      "path": "resources.graph.max_seconds",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 0,
      "results_affecting": true,

    {
      "path": "resources.max_requests",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 20000,
      "results_affecting": true,

    {
      "path": "resources.max_response_bytes",

      "path": "robots.unavailable_means_stop",

      "path": "robots.user_agent_token",

      "path": "scope.exclude_extensions",

      "path": "scope.include_media_types",

      "path": "scope.include_patterns",

    {
      "path": "scope.normalize_tracking_parameters",

      "default": true,

    },
    {
      "path": "scope.segments",
      "type": "list",
      "default": [],

A URL matching none of them is the built-in 'default' segment, so every URL belongs to exactly one segment, always."

      "path": "scope.segments_only",

    },
    {
      "path": "speed.adaptive",
      "type": "bool",
      "default": true,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Increase the delay automatically when the target slows down or times out."
    },
    {
      "path": "speed.concurrency",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 1,
      "results_affecting": false,

    {
      "path": "speed.max_delay_seconds",

    },
    {
      "path": "speed.min_delay_seconds",
      "type": "float",
      "default": 0.5,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Minimum delay between requests; the floor beneath adaptive back-off."
    },
    {
      "path": "speed.stop_after_consecutive_timeouts",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 5,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Stop the crawl after this many timeouts in a row."
    },
    {
      "path": "storage.body_mode",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "captured_entity_bytes",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "SQLite only: captured_entity_bytes retains fetched HTML/DOM; off retains metadata only."
    },
    {
      "path": "storage.capacity_profile",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "stable",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "'stable' (default) admits explicit URL limits up to 1,000,000; native SQLite max_urls=0 disables the URL limit while retaining independent resource guards. 'experimental_synthetic' is the compatible direct-storage fixture marker; live collectors refuse that marker. Neither setting certifies measured capacity."
    },
    {
      "path": "storage.format_version",
      "type": "str",
      "default": "scan.v1",
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "Explicit scan storage format: scan.v1 (default) or scan.v2 for optional graph/event extensions."
    },
    {
      "path": "storage.history_warning_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 21474836480,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "SQLite only: history-size warning threshold; never enables automatic deletion."
    },
    {
      "path": "storage.max_body_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 5242880,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "SQLite only: maximum decoded bytes retained for one complete body."
    },
    {
      "path": "storage.max_body_store_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 10737418240,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "SQLite only: total unique encoded body bytes retained per scan."
    },
    {
      "path": "storage.min_free_bytes",
      "type": "int",
      "default": 1073741824,
      "results_affecting": true,
      "description": "SQLite only: filesystem reserve; low space interrupts collection with a checkpoint."
    }
  ],
  "capabilities": {
    "sitemap_only_retained": true,
    "full_site_native_sqlite": true
  }
}
